label: VW e-Up BMS (model year required for cell layout and SOH)
applicable_models: VW e-Up / Skoda Citigo-e iV / SEAT Mii electric (2020+)

unavailable_fields.charge_port_temperature: Exposed by VW MEB charger ECU but DID not in any published list. Do not invent.
unavailable_fields.ID3_ID4_specific_request_ids: MEB BMS uses request 0x17FC0076 / response 0x17FE0076 (29-bit). DID set is similar but several DIDs (cell array base, SOH-MEC) are not in any open repo at byte resolution; community apps (Car Scanner) include them but are commercial.
